headline: The Desk is live with seven article-bound editorial illustrations, exact canonical copy, VaultSpark browser identity, and release-byte proof.

items.title: Seven source-bound editorial scenes
items.insight: Unique art is enforced at the brief, asset, and decoded-pixel layers, so a renamed generic template cannot pass.

items.title: Canonical News freshness is verified
items.insight: A purge and HTTP 200 no longer count as proof: description, icon contract, and representative art bytes must equal the candidate.
